education_overall.instructions: As of 2026-11-12, what is the highest education level completed? Use evidence in the CV, not an assumption that ongoing study is completed.

criteria.vocational_technical: Vocational or technical qualification below higher education.
criteria.short_cycle_higher: Short-cycle higher education, below a bachelor degree.
criteria.not_stated: No qualifying education stated within the requested scope/time window.

education_engineering.instructions: As of 2026-11-12, what is the highest education level completed or explicitly expected to be completed within 6 months after that date in engineering? Use evidence in the CV, not an assumption that ongoing study is completed.

criteria.vocational_technical: Vocational or technical qualification below higher education.
criteria.short_cycle_higher: Short-cycle higher education, below a bachelor degree.
criteria.not_stated: No qualifying education stated within the requested scope/time window.

maintenance_experience.instructions: As of 2026-11-12, how much documented work experience does the CV show in building maintenance OR industrial maintenance? Count overlapping periods once. Use elapsed time, not a count of calendar years. Do not assume a listed skill was used throughout an entire role.

criteria.under_1: Under 1 year, including no evidenced duration.
